Synopsis:
    Spanish intelligence (CNI) warned both Moroccan counterparts and Madrid one day before a mass migrant crossing at Ceuta on July 30. Over 70,000 people crossed, with ~140 deaths estimated by NGOs. 10,000+ migrants remain in Ceuta. Declassified documents reveal prior knowledge of scale, contradicting statements by Spain's Foreign Minister. Morocco's border response was deemed passive. Political scrutiny is intensifying over operational failures.
